state.lastRunNotes: Today's board-wide surge (BTC +6.7%, alts up double/triple digits) is broad altseason/rate-cut beta plus a BTC short squeeze, not fresh idiosyncratic news - confirmed AVAX (Helicon/Aave RWA), UNI and BCH (CME futures Oct 19) and NEAR (Hyperliquid/Ondo) are all still running on catalysts already priced in when bought, with no new confirming headlines today. LTC and DOT are also just riding the broad rally (LTC has no project-specific driver despite high volume; DOT's ETF/governance catalysts are a week+ old and already reflected). The Trump-Xi summit happening today is a live macro risk (their last meeting knocked BTC down ~5%), which argues against opening new positions into the event. Growth (29.7% of NAV) and core (29.9% of NAV) are balanced within the band, so holding everything unchanged.

trades.horizon: Reassess at next FOMC meeting or if weekly ETF flows turn net-negative for 2 consecutive weeks
trades.rationale: US spot BTC ETFs took in $3.52B in August with only 5/21 sessions seeing outflows; over $648M in short positions unwound as price broke above $85k, and BTC is on a rare three-month winning streak. Establishing core position on this institutional-flow catalyst despite today's intraday pullback on rising bond yields.
trades.sentimentSummary: Bullish institutional flow narrative, but short-term choppy as yields rise; mixed but net positive.

trades.horizon: Reassess ahead of the Alpenglow Consensus Upgrade in October 2026

Sized as growth-sleeve position given higher volatility.
trades.sentimentSummary: Strong institutional accumulation narrative with a concrete upcoming technical catalyst.
